Nina Park: Flagging a small billing postmortem: invoices for 2026-03-20 show ~12.6k tokens overcount across two customers. Looks like a delayed backfill ran twice.

Eli Walker: Can you share the quick diagnostic?

Nina Park: SQL I used:
```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens_billed)-SUM(tokens_expected) AS overcount
FROM billing_ledger
WHERE invoice_date = '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY org_id
HAVING overcount > 0;
```

metering-bot: alert: backfill-duplicate detected, job=backfill-20260320, dup_events=12640

Juno Kim: I'll own remediation. Plan: 1) freeze billing queue for affected invoices, 2) run ledger-rollback for duplicate backfill id, 3) prepare credit memos, 4) legal + CSM notify. ETA: rollback + recon by EOD, credits next morning.

Eli Walker: Replayer dry-run command:
```bash
./backfill-tool --job backfill-20260320 --dry-run --detect-duplicates
```

Nina Park: Affected (sanitized): org-301 over=7600, org-512 over=50040 (typo? Wait check) actually org-512 over=5000. Total ~12.6k.

billing-bot: INFO: credit-memos queued pending ledger-fix job=ledger-fix-771

Juno Kim: Created remediation ticket FIN-8012 and uploaded verification CSV. Will post updates here after ledger-fix completes.

Nina Park: Please include USD conversions in the customer note. Use conversion rate $0.00033/token. Also add an action: add replay idempotency check and a scheduled ledger parity job (owner: Eli).

Eli Walker: Acknowledged. I'll draft the postmortem section for recurrence and set up parity alert (>5k delta/24h).

Nina Park: Thanks—keeping this thread as the single source for finance closure.
